title: One Love Art DAO – FRONTERA Exhibition at Hotel Yve
organizer: One Love Art DAO (Nonprofit 501c3) in collaboration with BrunchByFidel
type: Physical and Digital Exhibition + AR Art Walk
location: Hotel Yve, Downtown Miami (146 Biscayne Blvd area), Miami, FL
event_dates: November 30 – December 6, 2026 (exhibition all week; AR Art Walk Dec 3)
deadline: November 15, 2026 (original); flash call through end of weekend Nov 15-16, 2026
status: Open / Closing soon – still accepting as of Nov 15
fee_reason: None – completely free to artists. Nonprofit DAO model supporting community and global artists.
what_they_are_looking_for: Works that challenge understanding and shift perspectives. Theme: FRONTERA. Contemporary visual art – physical or digital, painting, photography, mixed media, AI-assisted, NFTs/minted or unminted on any chain. Global artists welcome.
includes_entry_details: Selected artists exhibited in gallery; access to related events including AR Art Walk, open studio, receptions.
application_questions_count: Minimal (approx 4-6): name, contact, short description of work/theme fit, artist bio or statement optional/short, social links
receipts_required: 1 primary art piece (image or link); optional additional links/portfolio or short bio
how_to_apply: Google Form: https://forms.gle/DjERA61QPdZEf19SA or X post method: follow @OneLoveArtDAO @FidelEverywhere, share ONE piece, tag a friend
notes: Free, Web3-friendly, clear deadline, includes exhibition and event access. Ideal for digital/physical artists. Verify form still open.

title: Render Foundation Large-Scale Projection Open Call
fee_reason: None – free application; selected artists receive Render Network credits covering rendering costs.
what_they_are_looking_for: Original digital art and visual arts for large-scale projection. 10-15 artists selected.
includes_entry_details: Exhibition exposure during Miami Art Week; technical support via credits.
application_questions_count: Standard Typeform (estimate 5-8): artist info, work details, images
how_to_apply: Typeform (link was on opencalls.ai or Render channels)
notes: Closed but excellent example of free digital/Web3-aligned opportunity with covered costs.

title: Downtown Miami Art Week – Les Couleurs / Aura Copeland Open Call
organizer: Les Couleurs Art Collective / Aura Copeland Gallery
deadline: Rolling (as of early Nov; check current)
fee: Likely participation fee based on wall space (historical: $165+)
fee_reason: Gallery space and production costs; prestigious multi-location Flagler District presence during Art Week. Only include if fee is justified by exposure.
what_they_are_looking_for: Contemporary art – painting, sculpture, etc. Emerging and established, local and international.
includes_entry_details: Exhibition across three galleries; VIP preview access.

notes: Check for current fee status before recommending. Prestigious downtown location.
